title: Has potential
body: Could be brilliant, but there’s not really enough content. The description “organizer, planner, games, tips” is overselling it a bit! It’s just tips. These tips repeat fairly quickly, and the one-a-day format is frustrating if you’re hungry for advice. The slider to reveal each day’s hack is awkward, and sometimes the notification opens the app on the previous day’s hack, meaning you have to force the app to close to get the new one. Overall, the real purpose of the app seems to be to promote the related Numo app rather than provide any meaningful help. And finally, and it pains me to poke at a neurodivergence issue, but nothing beats getting someone else to proof-read your content before you publish it. Sorry.
author: dotdotdotcomma

title: I don’t get it
body: The app shows a “hack” and an affirmation. That’s it. I suffer with my ADHD so I’m always looking for ways to help. I just can’t see any usefulness with this app. What am I missing?
